messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: automated pager triggered — elevated 5xx rate on /v1/generate (us-east-1). severity=P1, service=inference-runtime. Pager: @oncall-sre. Link: https://ops.redwood.example/alerts/5319999999 :rotating_light:
jamie: oncall-sre here, acknowledging. joining war room now. pls add owner and TL for mitigation :+1:
priya: im available. i'll take owner for mitigation and run triage. opening a temporary channel/bridge. war room: https://meet.redwood.example/rooms/ops-5319999999
marco: quick note — dashboards show spike started ~08:42 UTC, error class is 503 fronting edge gateway. adding logs snippet:
```
ERROR 2026-03-17T08:42:12Z request_id=abc123 route=/v1/generate status=503 backend_err="kvcache-miss-timeout" latency_ms=1203
```
priya: thanks marco. hypothesis: kvcache eviction + burst traffic causing slowdowns -> gateway 503. I'll start by scaling dedicated pool and enabling fallback routing to replica model (gpt-small-4b-quant)
ops-lead: please confirm customer impact before any public comms. What % traffic is affected and which customers?
marco: preliminary: 12% of generation requests in us-east-1 saw 5xx in the last 5m. Large enterprise customers A and C saw increased errors (correlated by api_key). no customer-facing incidents page published yet.
oncall-sre: pinging infra team to check autoscaler events and node health: `kubectl get pods -n runtime -l app=inference -o wide`
jamie: infra noticed a flurry of OOMs on kv-cache nodes 08:41-08:43. paging storage team to investigate evictions.
priya: mitigation plan (short): 1) add 2 pooling nodes to us-east-1, 2) enable fallback routing to smaller quantized replica, 3) clear hot prefix cache for top offending keys. executing step 1 now (scaling).
incident-bot: ACTION: autoscale request submitted by priya — +2 nodes requested. request_id=scale-5319999999-1
marco: customer comm draft below (internal review). keep it short and factual. We should hold send until we confirm mitigation reduces errors below 1%:
"We are investigating an elevated error rate affecting text generation in US-East. Some customers experienced temporary errors. Our team is actively mitigating and we will share updates in 30 minutes."
priya: suggested status page entry (short): status.redwood.example/incidents/5319999999 — Impact: generation requests may return 5xx in US-East; start time 2026-03-17T08:42Z; Mitigation: routing and capacity changes in progress; Next update ETA 30 minutes.
ops-lead: please include contact for customers with SLA concerns: priority-support@redwood.example. draft looks good. set update cadence every 30 minutes until resolved.
oncall-sre: scaling completed, nodes registering (3 new pods in Running). latency on control plane looks improved.
priya: enabling fallback routing now: `curl -X POST https://controlplane.internal/api/v1/routing/fallback -d '{"region":"us-east-1","target":"gpt-small-4b-quant"}'` (running)
marco: executing cache clear for top 50 prefixes now. command: `redis-cli --scan | grep prefix | xargs -L 50 redis-cli del` (running)
jamie: handoff note for next oncall: monitor 5xx rate, verify affected customers, confirm status page updates, and escalate to platform if errors persist >10 minutes.
priya: quick check-in: after scaling+fallback, 5xx rate dropped to ~2.3% in last 2m. continuing to monitor.
ops-lead: good. set a provisional owner rotation: priya will own until 09:30Z then hand to jamie unless resolved earlier. make sure incident timeline and steps are logged in the incident doc: https://confluence.redwood.example/incidents/5319999999
jamie: ack. i will prepare internal incident note and timeline. who will publish the first public status update?
marco: i'll post the initial status page entry once we hit stable <1% or at the 30m mark, whichever is earlier.
incident-bot: NOTE: page-update queued: draft created by marco (id=page-5319999999-d1).
priya: next steps: keep running mitigation scripts, collect logs for root-cause. sending customer outreach template to #support for review.
marco: support template (for triage teams): "We detected transient errors impacting text generation in US-East starting at 08:42 UTC. We are mitigating by routing and scaling; please provide any error logs and request_ids for affected calls. For urgent SLA impact, email priority-support@redwood.example."
ops-lead: thanks everyone. maintain cadence, update war room every 10 minutes until errors <1%. ping me directly if any customer escalations. :white_check_mark:
jamie: thanks — leaving a sticky note for post-incident RCA owners (infra + runtime + caching). continuing watch.
incident-bot: INCIDENT-5319999999 status=investigating severity=P1 participants=[priya, jamie, marco, oncall-sre, ops-lead]
